response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and infrastructure, but this role is explicitly Junior/Mid-level entry-level position. His seniority, compensation expectations, and career trajectory are a strong mismatch for an entry-level individual contributor role, despite his technical skills (TypeScript, React, Node.js, some AWS/Kubernetes) aligning well with the required stack.
strengths: Deep, broad full-stack expertise including TypeScript, React, Node.js and REST/GraphQL APIs, exceeding required skill level
Direct experience with AWS (CDK), Kubernetes, and Docker, covering several nice-to-have infrastructure skills
Proven ability to learn quickly, mentor others, and drive software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
concerns: Vastly overqualified — currently a Staff Software Engineer, not aligned with a junior/mid entry-level role
No evidence of NestJS or PostgreSQL specifically, though has adjacent experience (MongoDB, general SQL)
Likely mismatch in expectations around compensation, autonomy, and role scope; risk of quick disengagement or attrition
